findings.title: Scrolling inside any popover body snaps back to scrollTop 0 because the capture scroll listener re-runs the natural-height measurement
findings.evidence: Popover.tsx registers reposition as a capture scroll listener; reposition now calls measureNaturalHeight, which sets maxHeight none and reads offsetHeight, so the browser clamps body scrollTop to 0. Live, layout-1 1280x720, 140 files: body.scrollTop=500 reads 500 synchronously then 0 after 300ms; mouse wheel x3 gives 0,0,0 in all four layout/size cells. With naturalHeight forced to undefined (reverted mutation) the same script gives 500 retained and wheel 700, 900, 1100.
findings.consequence: REQ-012 R25 'scrolls inside the popup for the rest' is false: users see about 12 of 140 entries and cannot scroll to the others. Every consumer with a scrolling body regresses (Prompts, Agents, layout-2 Skills). The audit note's 'scrolls inside to the last of 140 entries' is unsupported.
findings.minimal_fix: Ignore scroll events whose target is inside the bubble in the scroll handler (or save and restore body.scrollTop around the measurement), measure only on open and resize, add a test that scrolls the body, and verify with a real wheel in Playwright.

findings.title: Popover tests do not exercise scrolling or repeated reposition, so F01 passed all gates
findings.evidence: Restoring the 120 px floor fails 2 of 12 Popover tests, so that guard is covered; but no test dispatches scroll on the body or checks scrollTop or a second measurement. npm test 96 passed, build and lint clean with F01 present.
findings.consequence: The regression is invisible to the test suite and to the R25 count-at-rest measurement.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a test that fires scroll on .stage-popover__body after open and asserts offsetHeight is not re-read or scrollTop is preserved.

findings.title: Sticky filter box pins 8 px below the scrollport top, so entries show above it while scrolling
findings.evidence: With measurement disabled and scrollTop 600: bodyTop 223.9, searchTop 231.9, elementFromPoint 3 px below body top is a .stage-html-viewer__file-option. At rest the search ends at 258.5 and the first entry starts at 264.9 (no overlap).
findings.consequence: Cosmetic: entries pass through the 0.5rem padding strip above the pinned field.
findings.minimal_fix: top: -0.5rem on .stage-html-viewer__search, or move the body padding into the picker.
